sections.name: 03-content-section
issues: MAJOR: Rich text content blocks are split differently. Original has 3 .w-richtext blocks (last one contains 25 children spanning sections 3-6). Next.js has 6 separate blocks (one per section heading). This causes cumulative vertical drift.

UL margin-bottom: Original UL elements have 16px margin-bottom; Next.js UL last-child gets 0px due to CSS specificity of the .w-richtext > :last-child rule zeroing it out, since in Next.js each section's UL is the last child of its .w-richtext container.
The 96px cumulative height difference arises from content layout drift caused by the split blocks.

sections.name: 04-book-test-cta
issues: MAJOR: Background gradient rendering differs. Original uses a <canvas> element (375x600) for a dynamic/animated gradient. Next.js uses a CSS linear-gradient(135deg, #B73A00, #F79732, #EF751B, #E05302). The gradient pattern and color distribution differ significantly.
The CTA text, button, and bottom feature items (Physician reviewed, CLIA-certified labs, HIPAA compliant) are identical in both versions.

sections.name: 07-similar-biomarkers
issues: MINOR: Chat widget overlay ('Hey there! Got any questions?' in original vs '2 Issues' badge in Next.js) causes bottom-of-section mismatch. Content itself is identical.

sections.name: 08-faqs
issues: MINOR: Chat widget and sticky navbar overlaps cause mismatches. FAQ content, structure (10 items), and heading are identical.

sections.name: 09-bottom-cta
issues: MINOR: Chat widget overlay difference at bottom. Background image, text, and button are identical.

sections.name: 10-footer
issues: MEDIUM: 'AI recommends Superpower...' text has different font size — original uses 16px, Next.js uses 14px. This causes different line wrapping and a 6px height difference (45px vs 39px).
MINOR: AI logo icons have slight rendering differences.
MINOR: Chat widget overlay at bottom differs between versions.

topIssuesSummary.issue: Canvas gradient vs CSS gradient — 28.38% mismatch
topIssuesSummary.fix: Either replicate the canvas-based gradient animation (the original uses Webflow's built-in gradient canvas), or capture the exact gradient stops and angles from the canvas to better match the CSS fallback.

topIssuesSummary.issue: Rich text block splitting causes 96px cumulative height drift — 10.47% mismatch
topIssuesSummary.fix: Merge sections 3-6 (Key benefits through What do my results mean) into a single .blog-rich-text.w-richtext container to match the original Webflow CMS rich text rendering. This would eliminate the UL margin-bottom issue and vertical drift.

topIssuesSummary.issue: Footer AI text font-size 14px vs 16px — 7.35% mismatch
topIssuesSummary.fix: Change the 'AI recommends Superpower...' text element font-size from 14px to 16px to match original.
